transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, what brings me in is... I keep making myself throw up after I eat. I end up doing it in the bathroom at work, or right when I get home. I really hate it, but... it's just started feeling like it's the only way I can calm down.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that feels excessive to you in a short period of time?

Yes, I do. When it happens, I can just... keep eating. I'll go through a full bag of chips, maybe some pastries I grabbed from the corner store on the way home, whatever leftovers are in the fridge, and a couple of sweet drinks. All in one sitting. I just eat it all before I even really notice how much is actually gone.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time happen?

It's been happening for months now. I'd say most weeks, I have at least a couple of these episodes where I just... eat way more than I ever meant to. And after it happens, I always try to undo it. I'll do that by throwing up, like I said, or sometimes I'll just fast for a while, or try to exercise it all off.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?

I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about if it's guilt, exactly. I mostly just... I just know as soon as I realize what I did, I have to fix it. I don't know if I feel guilty about the eating, I just feel like I need to get rid of it right away.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yes, definitely. If the scale goes up even just a little bit, or... or if my waistband feels tight under my work apron, I just panic. I feel like I've ruined everything and that I'll just be fat by the end of the day.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

It's happening a lot. Honestly, that's actually what brings me in to see you. I just keep making myself throw up after I eat. I'll do it in the bathroom at work, or... or right when I get home. I really hate doing it, but it's just... it's started feeling like the only way I can calm down.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time without throwing up afterwards?

Yeah, sometimes. If I eat a lot and don't throw up, I try to make up for it in other ways. Like, on the days after I eat too much, I just won't eat anything until really late. Or... I'll make myself walk and exercise a ton. I'll do it even when my legs are completely aching from standing at the cleaners all day. I just have to do something to work it off.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

Well, if you mean all of it together... the eating a lot and then trying to fix it, whether that's throwing up, or starving myself the next day, or walking for hours... it's been happening for months. I'd say most weeks, there are at least a couple of times where I eat way more than I ever intended to, and then I have to do one of those things to undo it.
How many times a week do you make yourself throw up after eating?

I'm not exactly sure on a specific number just for the throwing up part. Like I said, it's a mix of things... between the throwing up, the fasting, and the exercise, it's at least a couple of times a week total. But I don't really keep track of how many times it's specifically throwing up versus the other stuff.
How many times a week do you typically make yourself throw up after eating?

Like I was just saying, I really don't know the exact number for just the throwing up. I don't keep track of it like that. I just know that between all of it—the throwing up, the starving, the walking—it's at least a couple times a week. I couldn't tell you how many of those times are just the throwing up.
Is making yourself throw up something you do after almost every time you eat a large amount of food?

Yeah, pretty much. That's actually what brings me in... I just keep making myself throw up after I eat like that. I'll do it in the bathroom at the dry cleaners where I work, or right when I get home. I hate it, but... it's started feeling like the only way I can calm down after I eat that much.
Do you make yourself throw up after almost every time you eat?

No, not every single time. Like, if I just have a normal sandwich on my break or something small, I usually don't. It's really just after those times I was talking about, when I eat a whole lot of food at once. That's when I feel like I have to go do it.
Do you make yourself throw up after every episode of eating a large amount of food in a short time?

I mean, like I just said, yeah, pretty much. I don't know if it's every single time without fail, because I don't keep a log of it or anything... but if I eat a whole lot of food like that, I'm going to make myself throw up. I can't really think of a time recently where I haven't.
Do you make yourself throw up after every single episode of eating a large amount of food in a short time?
Yeah, like I was just saying... yes. Every single time I eat that much food all at once, I make myself sick right after. I really can't think of a time when I didn't.
